title: The Great Commute Race
intro: 一段早间节目的播报：三名记者在早高峰从同一栋楼出发，比一比哪种方式在城里出行最快。读的时候留意时态：开头用现在完成时报结果（have just found out、has surprised），接着用一般过去时讲昨天的经过（left、got there）；for 和 since 说的是到现在为止有多久。最后一段有个谁也没想到的结果。

sentences.en: Good morning, and welcome back to City Mornings.
sentences.zh: 早上好，欢迎回到《城市早安》。

sentences.en: So, what's the fastest way to get around the city in rush hour?
sentences.zh: 那么，早高峰在城里出行，哪种方式最快？

sentences.en: Three of our reporters have just found out, and the answer has surprised us all.
sentences.zh: 我们的三位记者刚刚找到了答案，结果让我们都大吃一惊。

sentences.en: Yesterday at eight, Rob, Nina and Holly left the same block of flats in Northfield and raced to the Town Hall.
sentences.zh: 昨天早上八点，Rob、Nina 和 Holly 从 Northfield 的同一栋公寓楼出发，比赛谁先到市政厅。

sentences.en: Rob went by bike, Nina took the metro and Holly took a taxi.
sentences.zh: Rob 骑车，Nina 坐地铁，Holly 打车。

sentences.en: Rob got there first, at 8:31.
sentences.zh: Rob 第一个到，八点三十一分。

sentences.en: "It was hard work keeping up with the other cyclists," he told us.
sentences.zh: 「要跟上别的骑车的人，可真够累的，」他告诉我们。

sentences.en: Nina's journey was relaxing, but crowded.
sentences.zh: Nina 这一路挺轻松，就是挤。

sentences.en: She was reading her book when the man next to her fell asleep on her shoulder — and started snoring.
sentences.zh: 她正看着书，旁边的男人靠在她肩上睡着了——还打起了呼噜。

sentences.en: She arrived at 8:52.
sentences.zh: 她八点五十二分到。

sentences.en: And poor Holly.
sentences.zh: 再说可怜的 Holly。

sentences.en: Her taxi got stuck on the bridge for twenty-five minutes.
sentences.zh: 她的出租车在桥上堵了二十五分钟。

sentences.en: She was running late for a meeting, and she finally turned up at ten past nine.
sentences.zh: 她开会眼看要迟到，最后九点十分才赶到。

sentences.en: "I've never paid so much to sit still," she said.
sentences.zh: 「我还从没花这么多钱，就为了坐着一动不动，」她说。

sentences.en: She's already ordered a bike.
sentences.zh: 她已经下单买自行车了。

sentences.en: So, for a short commute, cycling saves time and money — at least when it isn't raining.
sentences.zh: 所以，路程不远的话，骑车省时又省钱——至少不下雨的时候是这样。

sentences.en: But the real star turned out to be Mr Harris.
sentences.zh: 不过，真正的明星原来是 Harris 先生。

sentences.en: He's seventy-two, and he's lived in the same block of flats since 1981.
sentences.zh: 他七十二岁，从 1981 年起就住在这栋楼里。

sentences.en: He was only going to the newsagent's next to the Town Hall.
sentences.zh: 他只是要去市政厅旁边的报刊店。

sentences.en: He went on foot, took a shortcut through the park and got there second, at 8:40.
sentences.zh: 他走路去的，抄近道穿过公园，八点四十分到，排第二。

sentences.en: "I've walked this way every day for forty years," he said.
sentences.zh: 「这条路我每天走，走了四十年了，」他说。

sentences.en: "And the park doesn't have traffic lights."
sentences.zh: 「再说，公园里又没有红绿灯。」

sentences.en: Anyway, that's all for now — back after the news.
sentences.zh: 好了，今天就到这儿——新闻之后见。

cards.note: to travel from place to place
the busy time of day when most people are travelling to or from work
cards.tip: 前面常用 in 或 during：in rush hour / during the rush hour；早高峰是 the morning rush hour。
cards.example: I try not to take the metro in rush hour.

cards.note: to get information about something, often by asking someone or by chance
cards.tip: find out 后面可以不带宾语：We've just found out.（我们刚弄清楚。）也常接 why / how / whether 引出的一句话。
cards.example: We need to find out which users are affected.

cards.note: 英式说法，美式说 apartment building；文中后面简称 the same block。
to move or make progress at the same speed as someone or something
cards.tip: 跟上速度、进度、变化都能用：keep up with the news；跟不上是 can't keep up with。
cards.example: It's hard to keep up with all the new Swift features.

cards.note: cycle（骑车）+ -ist；cycling 是骑车这件事：Cycling saves time。
a crowded train 挤满人的车；crowd 是名词「人群」。
to be unable to move, or unable to continue with something
cards.tip: get stuck in traffic 堵在路上；get stuck on a problem 卡在某个问题上。说状态用 be stuck：We're stuck.
cards.example: I got stuck on the same bug for two days.

cards.note: to be later than you planned
cards.tip: 说过去用 was running late；晚了哪件事用 for：running late for a meeting。
cards.example: The 8:15 train is running late again.

cards.note: to arrive, often late or when people are not sure you will come
sit still 坐着不动，stand still 站着不动；常见的副词意思是「仍然」。
也能当动词：commute to work 通勤上班；通勤的人是 commuter。
to need less time to do something
cards.tip: save sb time 省下某人的时间：This tool saves us an hour a day。time 前面不加 the。
cards.example: Using a template saves time when we write release notes.

cards.note: used to say that a bad situation has one good point; not less than
cards.tip: 这里的 at least 给前面的话加个限制：骑车又快又省钱——起码天气好的时候是这样。
cards.example: The new office is great — at least when the lift works.

cards.note: to happen in a way you did not expect, or to be discovered to be true
英国街角卖报纸、零食的小店；the newsagent's 是 the newsagent's shop 的省略，类似 the chemist's（药店）。

cards.tip: 交通方式一般用 by：by bike、by taxi、by metro；步行例外，说 on foot，不说 by foot。
cards.example: The office is ten minutes from the station on foot.

cards.note: to go a quicker or shorter way
cards.tip: 穿过某处用 through，沿着某处用 along。shortcut 还指电脑的快捷键：a keyboard shortcut。
cards.example: We took a shortcut through the car park and got there early.
